title: Canonical descent data for a finite scheme Čech comparison
statement:
Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse system of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine transition maps $p_{kj}:D_k\to D_j$ for $j\leq k$, and $(X,\pi_j)$ its limit [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For a scheme map $q:Y\to Z$, write $B_q$ for base change on the small étale categories, $q^*$ for inverse image on abelian sheaves, and $\eta_{q,H}(T):H(T)\to(q^*H)(B_qT)$ for the evaluated unit of $q^*\dashv q_*$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let $F_j$ be abelian sheaves on $D_j$, with maps $\varphi_{jk}:p_{kj}^*F_j\to F_k$. They satisfy $\varphi_{jj}$ equal to the canonical identity comparison and $\varphi_{j\ell}=\varphi_{k\ell}\circ p_{\ell k}^*(\varphi_{jk})\circ\chi_{jk\ell}$, where $\chi$ is the canonical inverse-image composition comparison. Let $G:I\to\mathrm{Ab}(X_{\acute et})$ have isomorphisms $g_j:G_j\simeq\pi_j^*F_j$ with $G(j\leq k)=g_k^{-1}\circ\pi_k^*\varphi_{jk}\circ\chi_{jk}\circ g_j$, where $\chi_{jk}:\pi_j^*F_j\simeq\pi_k^*p_{kj}^*F_j$ uses $p_{kj}\circ\pi_k=\pi_j$. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone of $G$, put $H=L.\mathrm{pt}$, and write $\lambda_j:G_j\to H$ for its legs. Let $U$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated étale object over $X$, $K$ a finite set, and $(f_k:V_k\to U)_{k\in K}$ a covering in its small étale topology, each $V_k$ quasi-compact quasi-separated. A Čech complex here is the cochain complex in nonnegative degrees whose degree $n$ is the product over $t:\{0,\ldots,n\}\to K$ of sections on $\prod_{a=0}^n V_{t(a)}$ over $U$, with alternating face differential [def-weil-pbc-cech-complex, def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-pbc-category-fibre-product]. There exist a stage, a descended family, the nerve identifications, and the complex diagram and cocone, satisfying all the following constructions and equations (no colimit property is asserted): The data and equations below have the following meaning. Choose $i_0\in I$, quasi-compact quasi-separated étale objects $U_0,V_{0,k}$ over $D_{i_0}$ and arrows $f_{0,k}:V_{0,k}\to U_0$. Choose isomorphisms $e_U:B_{\pi_{i_0}}U_0\simeq U$, $e_{V,k}:B_{\pi_{i_0}}V_{0,k}\simeq V_k$, satisfying
\[e_U\circ B_{\pi_{i_0}}(f_{0,k})=f_k\circ e_{V,k}.\]
On $J=\{j\in I\mid i_0\leq j\}$ define, by actual base change, $U_j=B_{p_{ji_0}}U_0$, $V_{j,k}=B_{p_{ji_0}}V_{0,k}$ and $f_{j,k}=B_{p_{ji_0}}f_{0,k}$; require every $(f_{j,k})$ to cover $U_j$. For each $n\geq0$ and tuple $t:\{0,\ldots,n\}\to K$, let $W_0(n,t)=\prod_{a=0}^n V_{0,t(a)}$ over $U_0$, with projections $r_{0,a}$, and let $W_j(n,t)=B_{p_{ji_0}}W_0(n,t)$ and $W_X(n,t)=B_{\pi_{i_0}}W_0(n,t)$. Let $N_j(n,t)=\prod_{a=0}^n V_{j,t(a)}$ over $U_j$, with projections $r_{j,a}$, and $N_X(n,t)=\prod_{a=0}^n V_{t(a)}$ over $U$, with projections $r_{X,a}$. Choose isomorphisms $z_j:W_j(n,t)\simeq N_j(n,t)$ and $z_X:W_X(n,t)\simeq N_X(n,t)$ in the respective small étale categories satisfying, for every $a$,
\[r_{j,a}\circ z_j=B_{p_{ji_0}}(r_{0,a}),\qquad r_{X,a}\circ z_X=e_{V,t(a)}\circ B_{\pi_{i_0}}(r_{0,a}).\]
For every arrow $a:j\to k$ in $J$, choose $\gamma_a:B_{p_{kj}}W_j(n,t)\simeq W_k(n,t)$ over $D_k$, and choose $\delta_j:B_{\pi_j}W_j(n,t)\simeq W_X(n,t)$ over $X$. These are prescribed by the equations on their underlying scheme maps
\[\operatorname{pr}_{W_0}^{W_k}\circ\gamma_a=\operatorname{pr}_{W_0}^{W_j}\circ\operatorname{pr}_{W_j}^{B_{p_{kj}}W_j},\qquad \operatorname{pr}_{W_0}^{W_X}\circ\delta_j=\operatorname{pr}_{W_0}^{W_j}\circ\operatorname{pr}_{W_j}^{B_{\pi_j}W_j}.\]
Each $\operatorname{pr}$ denotes the first projection of the indicated fibre product; their base projections are already fixed by being morphisms over $D_k$ or $X$. All these choices and equations are quantified for every $n,t$. Let $A:J\to\mathrm{CochainComplex}(\mathrm{Ab},\mathbb N)$, let $e_j:A_j\simeq\check C^\bullet((f_{j,k}),F_j)$, let $c_A$ be a cocone on $A$, and let $e_X:c_A.\mathrm{pt}\simeq\check C^\bullet((f_k),H)$. Define the tuple projections after these identifications by
\[T_{j,n,t}=F_j(z_j)\circ\operatorname{pr}_t\circ e_j^n:A_j^n\to F_j(W_j(n,t)),\quad T_{X,n,t}=H(z_X)\circ\operatorname{pr}_t\circ e_X^n:c_A.\mathrm{pt}^n\to H(W_X(n,t)),\]
where evaluation of a sheaf on an étale arrow is contravariant. Define the canonical section maps
\[\alpha_{a,n,t}=F_k(\gamma_a^{-1})\circ\varphi_{jk}(B_{p_{kj}}W_j(n,t))\circ\eta_{p_{kj},F_j}(W_j(n,t)),\]
\[\beta_{j,n,t}=H(\delta_j^{-1})\circ\lambda_j(B_{\pi_j}W_j(n,t))\circ g_j^{-1}(B_{\pi_j}W_j(n,t))\circ\eta_{\pi_j,F_j}(W_j(n,t)).\]
The required equations prescribing every diagram transition and every cocone leg are
\[T_{k,n,t}\circ A(a)^n=\alpha_{a,n,t}\circ T_{j,n,t}\quad(a:j\to k),\qquad T_{X,n,t}\circ(c_A.\iota_j)^n=\beta_{j,n,t}\circ T_{j,n,t}\quad(j\in J),\]
for every $n,t$.

source.place: Tag 09YP, lemma-colimit, proof: displayed equality of Cech complexes by degree-zero continuity. Scheme realization: etale-cohomology.tex Tag 09YQ; degree-zero continuity: sites.tex Tag 09YN.

proof.text: Spread out the qcqs finite-presentation étale objects U and V_k and all covering arrows, descend étaleness, then descend surjectivity of their finite disjoint union to a common stage. This gives U₀,V₀,f₀,eU,eV with the covering-arrow descent equation.

Use actual base change for all later families. Coverings remain coverings. Preservation of finite limits gives the nerve isomorphisms eNj and eNlim with each projection equation. Cartesian-square pasting gives γ and δ; being over the new base, their first-projection equations determine their maps uniquely.

Evaluate the coefficient adjunction units on the pulled-back nerve objects. Compose with φ and γ inverse for every transition, and with eG inverse, L.ι and δ inverse for the legs. Naturality commutes with each face, hence with the alternating differentials. The coefficient laws and hG give functor and cocone laws. Construct the complex maps directly by these pointwise formulas and product universal properties; no strictification or section-colimit theorem is used in this construction.

theorem exists_etale_limit_finite_cech_stage_data
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L)
    (U : c.pt.Etale) [CompactSpace U.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U.left]
    (K : Type (u + 1)) [Finite K] (V : K → c.pt.Etale) (f : ∀ k, V k ⟶ U)
    (hV : ∀ k, CompactSpace (V k).left ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace (V k).left)
    (hf : Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ c.pt.smallEtaleTopology U) :
    ∃ (i₀ : I) (U₀ : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale)
    (V₀ : K → (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale) (f₀ : ∀ k, V₀ k ⟶ U₀)
    (eU : (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj U₀ ≅ U)
    (eV : ∀ k,
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj (V₀ k) ≅ V k),
    let J := {j : I // i₀ ≤ j}
    let B := fun j : J ↦
      MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)
    let Blim := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))
    let Uj := fun j : J ↦ (B j).obj U₀
    let Vj := fun (j : J) (k : K) ↦ (B j).obj (V₀ k)
    let fj := fun (j : J) (k : K) ↦ (B j).map (f₀ k)
    let W₀ := fun (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) ↦
      (∏ᶜ fun a ↦ Over.mk (f₀ (t a))).left
    let pr₀ := fun (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) (a : Fin (n + 1)) ↦
      (Pi.π (fun a ↦ Over.mk (f₀ (t a))) a).left
    let Wj := fun (j : J) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) ↦ (B j).obj (W₀ n t)
    let Wlim := fun (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) ↦ Blim.obj (W₀ n t)
    let Nj := fun (j : J) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) ↦
      (∏ᶜ fun a ↦ Over.mk (fj j (t a))).left
    let Nlim := fun (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) ↦
      (∏ᶜ fun a ↦ Over.mk (f (t a))).left
    let Pj := fun (j : J) (n : ℕ) ↦
      fun t : Fin (n + 1) → K ↦ (F j.val).obj.obj (op (Nj j n t))
    let Plim := fun (n : ℕ) ↦
      fun t : Fin (n + 1) → K ↦ L.pt.obj.obj (op (Nlim n t))
    ∃ (A : J ⥤ CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ℕ)
      (eA : ∀ j : J, A.obj j ≅
        (cechComplexFunctor (fun k : K ↦ Over.mk (fj j k))).obj
          ((Over.forget (Uj j)).op ⋙ (F j.val).obj))
      (cA : Cocone A)
      (eK : cA.pt ≅ (cechComplexFunctor (fun k : K ↦ Over.mk (f k))).obj
        ((Over.forget U).op ⋙ L.pt.obj))
      (eNj : ∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K),
        Wj j n t ≅ Nj j n t)
      (eNlim : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K), Wlim n t ≅ Nlim n t)
      (γ : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K),
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
          (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Wj j n t) ≅ Wj k n t)
      (δ : ∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K),
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
          (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Wj j n t) ≅ Wlim n t),
      (CompactSpace U₀.left ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace U₀.left) ∧
      (∀ k, CompactSpace (V₀ k).left ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace (V₀ k).left) ∧
      (∀ k, Blim.map (f₀ k) ≫ eU.hom = (eV k).hom ≫ f k) ∧
      (∀ j : J, Sieve.ofArrows (Vj j) (fj j) ∈
        (D.obj (op j.val)).smallEtaleTopology (Uj j)) ∧
      (∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) (a : Fin (n + 1)),
        (eNj j n t).hom ≫ (Pi.π (fun a ↦ Over.mk (fj j (t a))) a).left =
          (B j).map (pr₀ n t a)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K) (a : Fin (n + 1)),
        (eNlim n t).hom ≫ (Pi.π (fun a ↦ Over.mk (f (t a))) a).left =
          Blim.map (pr₀ n t a) ≫ (eV (t a)).hom) ∧
      (∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K),
        (γ j k a n t).hom.left ≫
            pullback.fst (W₀ n t).hom (D.map (homOfLE k.property).op) =
          pullback.fst (Wj j n t).hom (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op) ≫
            pullback.fst (W₀ n t).hom (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)) ∧
      (∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K),
        (δ j n t).hom.left ≫ pullback.fst (W₀ n t).hom (c.π.app (op i₀)) =
          pullback.fst (Wj j n t).hom (c.π.app (op j.val)) ≫
            pullback.fst (W₀ n t).hom (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)) ∧
      (∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K),
        (eA j).inv.f n ≫ (A.map a).f n ≫ (eA k).hom.f n ≫
            Pi.π (Pj k n) t ≫ (F k.val).obj.map (eNj k n t).hom.op =
          Pi.π (Pj j n) t ≫ (F j.val).obj.map (eNj j n t).hom.op ≫
            ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
              (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).unit.app (F j.val)).hom.app
                (op (Wj j n t)) ≫
            (φ (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a)).hom.app
              (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
                (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Wj j n t))) ≫
            (F k.val).obj.map (γ j k a n t).inv.op) ∧
      (∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → K),
        (eA j).inv.f n ≫ (cA.ι.app j).f n ≫ eK.hom.f n ≫
            Pi.π (Plim n) t ≫ L.pt.obj.map (eNlim n t).hom.op =
          Pi.π (Pj j n) t ≫ (F j.val).obj.map (eNj j n t).hom.op ≫
            ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
              (c.π.app (op j.val))).unit.app (F j.val)).hom.app (op (Wj j n t)) ≫
            (eG j.val).inv.hom.app
              (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
                (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Wj j n t))) ≫
            (L.ι.app j.val).hom.app
              (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
                (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Wj j n t))) ≫
            L.pt.obj.map (δ j n t).inv.op)
